messages.content: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle

- The pelican should be sitting on the seat with feet on the pedals
- The pelican should have its distinctive long beak with a throat pouch
- Wings could be gripping the handlebars or spread slightly

- Seat

- Chain ring

Handlebars at (360, 220) curving up and forward
